title: RBI Amendment Directions on Responsible Business Conduct - Loan Recovery Rules 2027
description: <cite index="74-1">RBI consolidated loan recovery instructions that were scattered across entity-specific rulebooks into one recovery-conduct standard that applies to banks, NBFCs and housing finance companies alike.</cite> <cite index="74-2">Key changes include: the definition of recovery agency now ignores contractual labels, compensation to borrowers is a mandatory policy element rather than a courtesy, and device locking is prohibited by default with a narrow, heavily conditioned exception.</cite> <cite index="74-3,74-13">These directions come into effect on 1 January 2027 and lenders have until then to comply.</cite>
